_comment: 50-epoch CIFAR-10 with augmentation, batch 64 (paper Fig. 4 left, L=0 curve; Fig. 5 weighted-softmax curve). Read off the plots: L=0 test acc ~0.50 (T=1), ~0.59 (T=3), ~0.64 (T=10), ~0.61 (T=30); Fig. 5 GWS test ~0.63, train ~0.89. The paper does not state the selected eta/beta/momentum; the grid was eta in [0.3,1,1.5,3], beta in [20,30,40,60], T in [1,3,10,15,30], momentum in [0,0.1,0.9,0.999]. Memory (fp32): L=0 table = 2,499,264 rows x 3072 x 4 B = 30.7 GB -> needs a 40 GB GPU; L>=1 adds 61 GB per hidden layer and does not fit on one GPU without lower-precision storage. db_size = 64 + 781 steps/epoch x 64 x 50 epochs.
